nodes.title: SG-4.2.4 · Untrack the 15,329 tracked node_modules files via a tested cleanup script
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend still has 15,329 tracked files under node_modules (including phaser and its type-generation test files) plus the vitest results cache, which is currently an unmerged (UU) index entry. src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts already has trackedNodeModulesPaths, parseGitLsFiles, checkTrackedFiles and untrackNodeModules (git rm -r --cached), and scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts runs it through the npm script untrack:node-modules. Desired behavior: the cleanup verifies its own result, fails loudly if any path stays tracked, and reports counts, all covered by unit tests with a mocked git runner. Why: so the tracked dependency files can be removed reliably, and the guard run by npm test stays green.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a git runner that lists tracked node_modules files, when the cleanup runs, then it issues git rm -r --cached and re-lists the index to confirm none remain
- Given the index still lists a node_modules path after the rm, when the cleanup runs, then it throws naming the leftover paths
- Given the CLI helper, when cleanup succeeds, then it logs the untracked count and returns exit code 0, and on failure it logs the error and returns 1
- Given unit tests use a fake git runner, when they run, then no real git command executes and no file is deleted from disk


## Scope
- In scope: src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts verified cleanup and CLI helper
- In scope: scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts
- In scope: unit tests with a fake git runner
- Out of scope: Changing .gitignore rules
- Out of scope: Changing the assertNoTrackedNodeModules guard or the test script
- Out of scope: Deleting files from disk
- Preserve: Existing untrackNodeModules behavior and its tests
- Preserve: npm script untrack:node-modules
- Preserve: Phaser pinned to 3.90.x


## Technical constraints
- Use only git rm --cached, never delete working-tree files
- Git access goes through the injected GitRunner type


## Definition of done
- All acceptance criteria are covered by passing unit tests
- npm run typecheck passes


## Non-functional requirements
- Cleanup tests run in seconds with no real git


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Cleanup re-checks the index and fails when node_modules paths stay tracked
nodes.body:
Context: untrackNodeModules runs git rm -r --cached but never confirms the result, and unmerged (UU) paths such as node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json appear up to three times in git ls-files. Desired behavior: a new untrackAndVerify(run) counts unique tracked dependency paths before, runs untrackNodeModules, re-lists, and throws when any remain. Why: to prove all 15,329 files are removed.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a runner listing 3 node_modules paths, when untrackAndVerify runs and the second listing is empty, then it returns {before:3, after:0}
- Given the second listing still contains node_modules/phaser/package.json, when it runs, then it throws an error containing that path
- Given a path listed three times for merge stages, when counting, then it is counted once


## Scope
- In scope: untrackAndVerify in src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts
- Out of scope: Changing untrackNodeModules itself
- Preserve: untrackNodeModules call sequence


## Technical constraints
- Reuse checkTrackedFiles and untrackNodeModules


## Definition of done
- untrackAndVerify exported and typed


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · The CLI script reports the result and exits non-zero on failure
nodes.body:
Context: scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts calls untrackNodeModules directly with no output and no verification. Desired behavior: a testable runUntrack(run, log, err) returns 0 and logs the count on success, or logs the error and returns 1; the script sets process.exitCode from it. Why: so the npm script gives a clear pass or fail.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given untrackAndVerify succeeds with before=3, when runUntrack runs, then log receives a message containing 3 and it returns 0
- Given untrackAndVerify throws, when runUntrack runs, then err receives the message and it returns 1
- Given the script, when run, then it sets process.exitCode from runUntrack


## Scope
- In scope: runUntrack in src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts
- In scope: scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts
- Out of scope: package.json script names
- Preserve: npm script untrack:node-modules


## Technical constraints
- Script keeps execFileSync('git') as the real runner


## Definition of done
- Script uses runUntrack


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Add exported runUntrack(run: GitRunner, log: (m: string) => void, err: (m: string) => void): number that calls untrackAndVerify in try, logs `untracked ${before} paths` and returns 0, and in catch calls err with the Error message and returns 1.
Import runUntrack instead of untrackNodeModules and set process.exitCode to runUntrack(runner, console.log, console.error) where runner is (args) => execFileSync('git', args, { encoding: 'utf8' }).

steps.expected: Script sets exit code from runUntrack
